```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(ross.wq.tools)
`%nin%` = Negate(`%in%`)
```

# Finding the data...

```{r}
list.files("data/raw/sensor/manual_data_verification/", pattern = "*.parquet", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)%>%
  grep("boxcreek", ., ignore.case = TRUE,value = T)

## Each year's data
# 2023 is in: verified directory
# 2024 is in:verified directory
# 2025 is in: optical sensors in pre-verified directory, SC, Temp and Depth verified

```

## Load the data

```{r}
# Load the 2023 data
boxcreek_2023 <- map(list.files("data/raw/sensor/manual_data_verification/2023_cycle/in_progress/verified_directory/", pattern = "*.parquet", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)%>%
      grep("boxcreek", ., ignore.case = TRUE,value = T), read_parquet)%>%
  bind_rows()

# Load the 2024 data
boxcreek_2024 <- map(list.files("data/raw/sensor/manual_data_verification/2024_cycle/in_progress/verified_directory/", pattern = "*.parquet", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)%>%
      grep("boxcreek", ., ignore.case = TRUE,value = T), read_parquet)%>%
  bind_rows()

boxcreek_2025_non_ver <- map(list.files("data/raw/sensor/manual_data_verification/2025_cycle/in_progress/pre_verification_directory/", pattern = "*.parquet", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)%>%
      grep("boxcreek", ., ignore.case = TRUE,value = T), read_parquet)%>%
  bind_rows()
boxcreek_2025_ver <- map(list.files("data/raw/sensor/manual_data_verification/2025_cycle/in_progress/verified_directory/", pattern = "*.parquet", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)%>%
      grep("boxcreek", ., ignore.case = TRUE,value = T), read_parquet)%>%
  bind_rows()


all_boxcreek <- bind_rows(boxcreek_2023, boxcreek_2024, boxcreek_2025_non_ver, boxcreek_2025_ver)
```

# Quick plot

```{r }
all_boxcreek%>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("Temperature", "Specific Conductivity", "Depth"))%>%
  mutate(DT_round_MT = with_tz(DT_round, tz = "America/Denver"))%>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = DT_round, y = mean, color = verification_status))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y")
```

# Organize for Boxelder Sanitation Folks

```{r}

all_boxcreek_clean <- all_boxcreek%>%  
  mutate(DT_round_MT = with_tz(DT_round, tz = "America/Denver"), 
         quality_status = case_when(
           is.na(mean) ~ "Data Missing",
           !is_verified & !is.na(flag) ~ "Non Verified, Auto Flagged",
           !is_verified & is.na(flag) ~"Non Verified, No Auto Flag",
           is_verified & final_status == "PASS" ~ "Verified, PASSED", 
           is_verified & final_status == "FLAGGED" ~ "Verified, FLAGGED", 
           is_verified & final_status == "OMIT" ~ "Verified, FAILED", 
           TRUE ~ "Unknown Status"
         ), 
         value_cleaned = case_when(
           is.na(mean) ~ NA,
           !is_verified & !is.na(flag) ~ mean,
           !is_verified & is.na(flag) ~ mean,
           is_verified & final_status == "PASS" ~ mean, 
           is_verified & final_status == "FLAGGED" ~ mean, 
           is_verified & final_status == "OMIT" ~ NA, 
           TRUE ~ NA
         ), 
         qc_flag = case_when(
           is.na(mean) ~ NA,
           !is_verified & !is.na(flag) ~ flag,
           !is_verified & is.na(flag) ~ NA,
           is_verified & final_status == "PASS" ~ NA, 
           is_verified & final_status == "FLAGGED" ~ user_flag, 
           is_verified & final_status == "OMIT" & is.na(user_flag) ~ "Suspect Data", 
           is_verified & final_status == "OMIT" & !is.na(user_flag) ~ user_flag, 
           TRUE ~ NA
         )
         )%>%
  select(DT_round_MT,site, parameter, value_raw = mean, value_cleaned, units, quality_status, qc_flag )


```

## Apply smoothing

```{r}
apply_low_pass_binomial_filter <- function(df,
                                           site_col = "site",
                                           parameter_col = "parameter",
                                           dt_col = "DT_round_MT",
                                           value_col = "value_cleaned",
                                           new_value_col = "value_smoothed") {


  # 5-point binomial kernel [1,4,6,4,1]
  binomial_kernel <- function(int_vec) {
    kernel <- c(1, 4, 6, 4, 1)
    sum(int_vec * kernel) / 16
  }

  data_smoothed <- df %>%
    arrange(!!sym(site_col), !!sym(parameter_col), !!sym(dt_col)) %>%
    group_split(!!sym(site_col), !!sym(parameter_col)) %>%   # split into list of dfs
    purrr::map(~ {
      .x <- add_column_if_not_exists(.x, new_value_col)

      this_param <- dplyr::first(.x[[parameter_col]])

      if (!is.na(this_param) && this_param %nin% c("Temperature", "Depth")) {
        .x <- .x %>%
          mutate(
            # First pass
            !!sym(new_value_col) := data.table::frollapply(
              !!sym(value_col), N = 5, FUN = binomial_kernel,
              fill = NA, align = "center"
            )
          )
          # ),
          # # Second pass
          # !!sym(new_value_col) := data.table::frollapply(
          #   !!sym(new_value_col), n = 5, FUN = binomial_kernel,
          #   fill = NA, align = "center"
          # ),
          # # Third pass
          # !!sym(new_value_col) := data.table::frollapply(
          #   !!sym(new_value_col), n = 5, FUN = binomial_kernel,
          #   fill = NA, align = "center"
          # )
        #)
      } else {
        .x <- .x %>%
          mutate(!!sym(new_value_col) := NA_real_)
      }
      #Fill remaining NA in smoothed column with original values
      .x <- .x %>%
        mutate(
          !!sym(new_value_col) := if_else(
            is.na(!!sym(new_value_col)) & !is.na(!!sym(value_col)),
            !!sym(value_col),
            !!sym(new_value_col)
          )
        )
      return(.x)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows()   # put the list back together

  return(data_smoothed)


}

smoothed_bc <- all_boxcreek_clean %>%
  mutate(year = year(DT_round_MT))%>%
  split(list(.$year, .$parameter), drop = TRUE)%>%
  map(., apply_low_pass_binomial_filter)%>%
  bind_rows()%>%
  select(-year)%>%
  arrange(DT_round_MT)%>%
  mutate(DT_round_MT = as.character(DT_round_MT))%>%
  select(DT_round_MT, parameter, units, value_raw, value_cleaned, value_smoothed, quality_status, qc_flag)

p <- smoothed_bc%>%
  filter(parameter == "Temperature" & year(DT_round_MT) == 2025)%>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = DT_round_MT, y = value_cleaned))+
  geom_line(color = "red")+
      geom_line(aes(y = value_smoothed), color = "black")


ggplotly(p)

```
